overview: Ar y Ffin follows experienced Magistrate Claire Lewis Jones as she faces personal turmoil while presiding over cases at Newport Magistrates Court. When Ned Humphries, a childhood friend of Beca, Claire's daughter, faces arson charges, Claire's loyalty to her community is put to the test. Matters are made worse when local criminal kingpin Saint Pete appears on the scene. Claire and Saint Pete go back a long way – will her past come back to threaten her present? As she delves deeper into the case, and suspicions grow around her daughter's new bad-boy boyfriend, Sonny Higgins, Claire uncovers a web of criminal activity that could put her and her family at risk. As the truth emerges and consequences unfold, Claire must confront her own biases and decisions. The lines between right and wrong become blurred, as Claire's maternal instincts clash with her commitment to uphold the truth.
title: Ar y Ffin

overview: Bill Cosby stars as Hilton Lucas, a former airline worker forced into early retirement after a mass layoff. Other characters in this CBS sitcom include Hilton's wife Ruth, his daughter Erica and family friends Griffin and Pauline.
title: Cosby

overview: STAX: Soulsville U.S.A. tells the story of an underdog record label comprised of Black and white collaborators who ushered in the groundbreaking, industry-altering soul music of Otis Redding, Isaac Hayes, Booker T. & the M.G.'s, The Staple Singers, Sam & Dave and many others that defined a generation. Driven by instinct and defying the notion that Black artists needed to be "made marketable," the Memphis-based label went from ultimate outsider to one of the most influential producers of Black music – finding its place inside the broader mainstream record industry. Stax became more than a record label; it transformed into a beacon of Black freedom. It is a quintessentially American story of an audacious group of individuals who dared to make their own music on their own terms creating an institution that has continued to help define our culture long after the label itself has gone.
title: STAX: Soulsville U.S.A.

overview: Shay Mitchell explores the world one drink at a time as she visits exotic locations, samples unique ingredients, and meets expert hosts. On her journey, she encounters the latest drink trends, the best bars, and 8,000 years of sipping history.
title: Thirst with Shay Mitchell

overview: Anything can happen when best friends Martha Leivestad and Fetisha Williams meet every week to catch up.
title: Martha & Fetisha

overview: The cold and beautiful Kaolin Flower E Tokio, who after suffering a series of incidents such as bullying and violence, transformed and came back with a gorgeous transformation, started her own road of revenge with a well-thought-out plan, and finally gained inner redemption and love.
title: Misfeeling

overview: Mai Lingjing, a deaf housewife, seems to have an ideal life: a perfect husband, Wang Shiming, and a sweet bosom friend, Su Xi. However, her seemingly happy life is shattered into pieces when she accidentally regains her hearing. It turns out that her beloved husband has been cheating on her with her best friend, and the two are planning something horrible together. In order to find out what is really going on, Mai Lingjing has to suffer in silence and pretend to be deaf, so that she can get revenge on the two liars when keeping both of them in the dark.
title: Moment of Silence

overview: It's a Living takes place at a posh restaurant, Above the Top which is located on the top floor of a California high rise hotel. This series originally began in October of 1980 on ABC and ran for one season. ABC must have had faith in the show for it returned the following season under a new title, Making a Living. After that everyone thought they had seen the last of it, but in 1985, It's a Living restarted production for an additional four seasons which ran in syndication. The stories revolved around the waitresses (who've included: Lois, Jan, Dot, Cassie, Vicki, Maggie, Amy and Ginger) their boss and hostess, Nancy, and the piano man Sonny.
title: It's a Living

overview: Meng You, a young spiritual official with the ability to shake mountains with her tears, accidentally set free Li Bugui before he drank the Carefree Soup. This action caused turmoil in Lingyuan and put Meng You's Granny in danger. To rectify her error and rescue Granny's life, Meng You volunteered to travel to Qingchuan to complete the task of giving Li Bugui the soup. However, upon arrival, Meng You found that Li Bugui had become Qingchuan's top assassin, possessing formidable martial arts skills. To approach Li Bugui and complete her mission, Meng You embarked on a tumultuous journey filled with persuasion and chaos.
title: Life After Life

overview: The Chonga Girls follows two dangerously confident childhood friends, Mimi and Laura, who move from Miami to Hollywood to realize their dream of becoming famous. But, much to their surprise, they find themselves working at the makeup counter for a department store right off the Walk of Fame.
title: The Chonga Girls

overview: Ye Sibei's patience, compromise, and avoidance toward her parents' preference for sons over daughters made her husband, Qin Nan, who loved her deeply but was frustrated by her lack of resistance. He is unable to endure it any longer, leading him to file for divorce. However, at this moment, Ye Sibei faces an assault, plunging her into despair. Upon learning the truth, Qin Nan resolutely stays by her side, encouraging her to seek justice through legal means. With the intervention of the judicial system, the criminal is imprisoned, and the truth is revealed. Ye Sibei and Qin Nan support each other, resolve their family conflicts, and embark on a new chapter in life.
title: Light Beyond the Reed

overview: In the 70's, Doctor Nat, a dermato-venereologist who once dreamt of writing adventure novels and becoming a published author, ends up as the columnist behind "The Climax Question" — a space for answering questions everyone wants to ask but dare not. From masturbation and premature ejaculation to foreplay, STDs, and more, the column discusses forbidden subjects while keeping the inquirers' identities anonymous. Through his work on the newspaper column, Doctor Nat grows closer to Linda, the publisher's art department head. Their budding connection threatens to jeopardize not only the doctor's marriage with his perfect wife, Tukta, but also his family's old-money status.
title: Doctor Climax

overview: After unexpectedly reborn, the young girl Cheng Xinian learned the truth about her past life being manipulated and killed. She became allies with Su Jingyuan, who was infiltrating the Cheng family in order to avenge his family's blood feud. They cooperated tacitly, though they occasionally clashed with each other. Entwined with complex emotions of hatred and warmth, they moved forward hand in hand.
title: Rise from the Ashes

overview: Antique shop owner Bi Zhi from the future and modern-day veterinarian Su Beilu form a partnership to embark on a time-traveling quest to recover antiques. Through different eras' customs and traditions, as well as the twists and turns of life, their adventures are gradually revealed through the duo's careful guidance and collaboration. Along the way, they forge friendships that transcend time and space, ultimately facing their respective lives with optimism and hope.
title: The Company

overview: Captain Emelin, nicknamed Emelya, as well as his colleagues, captains Vasin and Dolbunov, are engaged in the most complex investigations, and forensic expert Masha Likhacheva helps them in this. Emelya's reputation is so-so, the head of the department, Colonel Khitruk, dislikes him for his independent character and intransigence, but he has to put up with a valuable employee, because he has good disclosure. Charisma, observation and the ability to think outside the box help Emelya quickly find criminals. And courage and determination, multiplied by strong fists, effectively neutralize them. His partner Vasin helps to find the necessary information from the Network and phones of victims and intruders. Dolbunov turned out to be the main irritant in the team: he is the employee who talks a lot and does not really do anything. He lives strictly according to the horoscope, and if he has a "bad day" according to the forecast, he will never go to detention. Besides work, Emelya has a purely friendly relationship with Masha Likhacheva. In moments of sad reflection, he goes to Masha for advice, who is well versed in both crimes and amorous affairs.
title: Емеля

overview: Tang Xiaoshan, an off-start constable, accidentally becomes the talented lady of Tao Hua City. However, as she is not well-versed in literary and arts, she hopes to get eliminated as soon as possible. However, she meets Ying Chengmo, the most talented scholar of the campus. Thus begins their love journey.
title: The Substitute Love

overview: The Xuankun Continent used to be reigned by five clans. Six years ago, the five clans had a war where the Human clan defeated the other four and established their dominant position. During the war, Princess Shuoye of the Spirit clan managed to escape but was nowhere to be found. Six years later, she got into the humans' palace, disguised as Lingzhi to find out the truth about the extinction of her clan and rescue her clansmen who were imprisoned by the humans. In the dangerous palace, Lingzhi behaved carefully, played things by ear, and finally approached Mu Xuanjue, the emperor of the humans. As the two of them tested each other, they gradually had feelings. Lingzhi eventually found out the truth. In the end, she and Mu Xuanjue worked together to defeat the villains and achieve the goal that the five clans would live in peace and harmony together.
title: Beauty Strategy

overview: Our House is an American television drama series that aired on NBC for two seasons from September 11, 1986 to May 8, 1988. The series centers on the Witherspoon family and the challenges they face adjusting to life with three generations living in the same house. After his son John dies, retired widower Gus Witherspoon (played by Wilford Brimley) invites his daughter-in-law Jessica 'Jessie' Witherspoon (played by Deidre Hall) and her three children to move to California to live with him until they can get back on their feet financially. Despite protests from her children, Jessie, along with 15-year-old daughter Kris (played by Shannen Doherty), 12-year-old son David (played by Chad Allen), eight-year-old daughter Molly (played by Keri Houlihan), and their basset hound named Arthur leave Fort Wayne, Indiana, to start their new lives in California. As they settle into life with Gus, they realize that he can be difficult to live with. A major part of the plot each week was centered on the conflict that can arise when extended family tries to live together in the same house. As the man of the house, Gus imposed rules on the three grandchildren the same way he raised his own children but later learned ways to convey his lessons to the kids without being gruff. Jessie and the kids learn that beneath Gus' stern facade is a man who is wise about the ways of the world and cares about them very much. In a feature reminiscent of the 1960s T.V. series The Wild Wild West, each of the five acts of the episode before commercial ended with a freeze-frame shot, which then occupied one of the rooms in an abstract rendering of a house figure. As the episode unfolded, more rooms were filled until finally, when the dilemma had been resolved, the final piece was put in place, completing the house. John Witherspoon (played by Patrick Duffy) was seen in one episode and in the occasional flashback.
title: Our House

overview: The boy listens to his grandfather's stories about the times of the USSR and finds himself in the 1950s. A nostalgic comedy series from producer Sarik Andreasyan based on the cycle of famous children's stories by Viktor Dragunsky. The film adaptation was directed by the writer's grandson, Artemy Dragunsky. Denis Viktorovich has been living on Karetny for a long time and he always has something to tell. When he is assigned to look after his grandson Denis, his grandfather begins to entertain the six-year-old boy with stories about another era. Their main character is the same age as Denis, who lived in the 1950s in the USSR. The mischievous man was constantly getting into trouble, but he learned lessons from his adventures. Denis, listening to his grandfather, is transported back in time and realizes that he and the boy from the middle of the last century have much more in common than it might seem.
title: Денискины рассказы

overview: Action is the adrenaline-fueled docuseries from 87North, the world-renowned production company of blockbuster filmmakers David Leitch and Kelly McCormick who are the force behind icon action tentpole films such as Bullet Train, Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw, and Atomic Blonde. In this series, their 87North stunt team takes center stage, revealing the captivating stories of ordinary individuals who are drawn to the electrifying world of action sports, martial arts, motocross and more. These daredevils navigate the high-octane, highly skilled, and often perilous world of film stunts, balancing their professional passion with the demands of everyday life. In Action, every exhilarating episode reveals the indomitable spirit and camaraderie that binds together this remarkable group of stunt people. Their shared dreams and love for all things action unite them as they carve their names into the annals of Hollywood history. But be prepared for more than just jaw-dropping stunts; delve into their personal lives and witness the sacrifices they make and the challenges they conquer while juggling the most unique day job on the planet.
title: Action

overview: Billy Corgan's Adventures in Carnyland, a new, 8-episode unscripted series streaming only on The CW, drops the curtain for a look at how Corgan balances life as the driving force behind rock icons The Smashing Pumpkins (Pumpkinworld) with work as a wrestling promoter and owner of the National Wrestling Alliance (Carnyland) while being a dedicated father in the midst of planning an epic wedding to his longtime love, Chloé Mendel.
title: Billy Corgan‘s Adventures in Carnyland

overview: Eight musical groups whose popularity peaked in the 80s–90s and 2000s will compete for the title of "superstars."
title: ВИА Суперстар!

overview: It all began on April 20, 1988, during an episode of Growing Pains entitled "How the West Was Won". When Mike Seaver's favorite teacher, Coach Lubbock, loses his job, Mike and Boner discover that the coach has nine mouths to support. So what happens? Coach Lubbock uproots his family and moves them to Eureka, California, where he becomes the coach at St Augustine's Academy, a Catholic school. The twist? It's an all-boys school, and he has five daughters to enroll. Sexcapades abound, but a lesson is always learned. The Lubbock clan included Graham's wife, Elizabeth, a Catholic woman with a lot of faith and values; J.R, a pre-teen delinquent who delighted in watching scary movies and terrorizing his sisters; Sherrie, the resident pre-teen brainiac; and toddlers Harvey and Melissa. The main focal point of the series were the beautiful Lubbock Babes: repressed and nun-like Marie, t...
title: Just the Ten of Us

overview: In the music show, 10 legends of Soviet and Russian pop music from the late 80s and early 90s compete for the title of "real superstar." In order to win, artists must overcome 10 competitive stages, in which all their talent and creativity will be demonstrated.
title: Ты — суперстар!

overview: Two teams took part in the show - "Team USSR" and "Team Russia" - 10 participants each.
title: Суперстар-2008. Команда мечты

overview: Sins of the South is a riveting new true crime series that illuminates the drama, the history and the crime stories found below the Mason-Dixon line. With a deliciously delightful Southern inflected narration, each of the 12-hour-long episodes unravel the twists and turns of a real-life murder, highlighting the disturbing crimes of the South and the wickedness that led to it. First-hand accounts from victims' loved ones and law enforcement, archival footage and cinematic recreations bring these sinful stories to life.
title: Sins of the South

overview: Zhen Miao, an eccentric college student pastry chef, unexpectedly broke into the world of script killing and got engaged to Luo Tianjue, a handsome senior who was different from her. The two went from being disgusted with each other to being in love with each other, and started a new life together. A sweet romantic journey.
title: Ally Tiancheng Wonderful Accident

overview: Discover biotopes and endemic species that have evolved over millions of years, but are now at risk from deforestation and climate change.
title: Ecuador: On the Wild Side

overview: The innocent and cute "little pig demon" coveted the demon-catching treasure gourd of the demigod Feng Pan. He wanted to steal the treasure, but was forced to stay by the sinister and domineering Feng Pan. From then on, one god and one demon embarked on a journey of catching demons with laughter and tears.
title: Spring Flowers Are Blooming Chen Xiaozhu

overview: The sound of the vibrating engine hummed in the night, the broken car windows pierced the fog, and the dim yellow car lights illuminated the road ahead. Even though we were stuck in the mud, we still had hope.
title: Invisible Engine

overview: Jonathan Ames continues to ply his trade as an unlicensed private detective, getting caught up in increasingly risky jobs and absurd adventures around New York City with George and Ray, his always supportive partners in solving crime. In addition, a shocking revelation drives him to embark on one of his most important cases yet, the quest to find his biological father. As if that wasn't enough, Jonathan's writing career is finally starting to look up with the publication of his long-delayed second book.
title: Bored to Death

overview: A sassy, sexy, funny, cheeky multi-platform drama for young adults. Set in the steamy streets of tropical Brisbane, Slide follows the unpredictable exploits of a teenage collective of friends, and enemies, as they prepare to face life after school.
title: SLiDE

overview: Retired ballet artist Tan Siting returns to China, wanting to seek a second chance with Feng Rui, the lover she was once forced to leave behind. But past misunderstandings have built a wall between them. Feng Rui's orderly life as a a single father is thrown into chaos by her reappearance. Meanwhile, Tan Siting is accompanied by a man who has loved her from afar for a decade. As Tan Siting and Feng Rui try to avoid each other, fate keeps forcing them together, leaving them trapped in a turbulent mix of love and heartache.
title: Second Chance Romance

overview: The wandering physician Ye Ping An, entangled in an old and secretive case, arrives in Chang'an. Accused of mystical medical interventions, she manipulates minds and evokes fear, while the low-born magistrate Yuan Shao Cheng, craving power, seizes the opportunity to rise. A murder in Chang'an implicates Ye Ping An, but is she truly an innocent scapegoat or a mastermind plotting revenge? The first move in her intricate scheme has already unraveled.
title: Kill My Sins

overview: Genius engineer Chen Xiao was introduced to a rival company by headhunter Shen Nuo, and was designed by his former partner Qi Jialun. After his mother passed away, he started his entrepreneurial journey with the company and encouragement of Shen Nuo, and finally broke the Western monopoly on artificial intelligence with his former brothers.
title: My Talent Neighbour

overview: Wu Tong, as an elderly working mother who has to do everything well, slowly adapted to the adjustment with the understanding and support of her husband Hu Yichuan. In the postpartum confinement center, Wu Tong met the perfect mother Song Bingxue and her writer husband Tang Mucheng, the post-00s "bottom" hot mom Li Lu, single parent celebrity mother Jin Yutong and others. Faced with postpartum difficulties, mothers understand and encourage each other, and break through and grow together on the road of parenting.
title: Inspire Me

overview: Lady Jun Qinglan's family is wiped out in a massacre. Her former fiancé, Li Congyao, not only refuses to help but personally disfigures her. She barely escapes with her life, changes her identity, disguises herself as a man, and becomes a coroner at the Dali Temple — biding her time, waiting for the chance to seek justice and revenge. But when she crosses paths with Li Congyao again, the man she once loved has become a ruthless and cruel prince, who forcibly takes her and holds her captive. Caught between love and hatred, intrigue and betrayal, layers of old mysteries begin to surface — and a deadly game of vengeance and desire begins anew.
title: The Legendary Chitose-Sama

overview: Set in the future, a group of young people get caught up in a mysterious AI controlled game.
title: Players

overview: The story revolves around the romance of Hua Zhuyu, who disguises as a male to enter the battlefield; and Feng Junli, the prime minister of South Dynasty
title: Love Under the Floral Rain

overview: Arjen, one of the world's most dangerous assassins, is tested with his conscience in his last mission
title: Arjen

overview: In a distant corner of the universe, a galaxy is at war. Rebels battle for freedom; villains fight for control. But the true heroes are the ones cleaning up the mess…
title: Space Janitors

overview: The appearance of the program participants does not allow them to establish a personal life, and those around them do not take them seriously. Project stylist Sasha Podielskaya will select a stylish and feminine wardrobe for the girls, and makeup artists will teach how to take care of their hair and do the right makeup.
title: Дурнушек.net

overview: "Reboot" is a show of incredible transformations. The participants in the project are ordinary girls who find themselves in a difficult situation. They have different stories, but they all have one thing in common: "Reboot" is the first step towards a new happy life. The main goal of the show is not only external transformation, but also internal transformation, behind which lies the painstaking work of specialists. Presenter Ksenia Borodina and her team will prove to the project participants that they deserve the best. Psychologists, fitness trainers, plastic surgeons, stylists, cosmetologists and makeup artists work with the girls for a whole month.
title: Перезагрузка

overview: Eight hot, young singles arrive to an amazing villa in Los Cabos, San Lucas for the vacation of a lifetime.
title: Sueltos en Los Cabos

overview: In the first season of Comedy Class, Eric and Ramzy go in search of new comedy talent in Paris, Nantes, Marseille, and Brussels. Throughout the Comedy Class adventure, the mentors are joined by special guests.
title: Comedy Class par Éric & Ramzy

overview: Asya, Lera and Nadya are best friends since school. Each of them has their own well-established life, but relationships with men do not work out. After 20 years of marriage, Nadya's husband left for his pregnant secretary. Lera got married right after school and gave birth to a child, but she has been raising her son on her own for a long time. Her lover Kostya is married and has no intention of leaving the family. Asya has never been married and has no children. With the appearance of Igor in her life, everyone thinks that they are a wonderful couple. But Igor doesn't think so. Tired of eternal problems with men, the friends take an oath to each other that from now on there will be no traitors in their lives. Girls no longer believe in relationships and will not allow men to ruin their lives. But even the strongest vows lose their power when true love comes...
title: Зонтик для подруг

overview: The young and successful musician Danya - Sorry - encountered difficulties communicating with girls. He feels awkward and unsure of himself and needs help learning how to communicate properly with the opposite sex.
title: #Даняизвини

overview: "Tribe" is a Russian reality show on the "Friday!" channel, in which the stars of domestic show business will have to survive alone with a wild tribe.
title: Племя

overview: The heroes of the "Call of Blood" project grew up in single-parent families and were raised in orphanages. But they did not lose hope of finding answers to the damned questions about the mystery of their birth. Participants in "Call of Blood" go in search of the people closest to them – their mothers or fathers. They are ready to travel kilometers for the sake of their goal. This journey is the main thing in their lives. Because there is nothing stronger than the call of blood.
title: Зов крови

overview: The greatest thinkers/comedians of our time ask the questions no one else will.
title: Smartypants

overview: Really Me is a Canadian teen situation comedy series airing on Family. It premiered on April 22, 2011 and on VRAK.TV August 31, 2011. The series centers is about a fifteen-year-old girl named Maddy (Sydney Imbeau) who wins a contest to get her own reality TV show with her best friend Julia (Kiana Madeira). But being a star isn't as easy as Maddy had thought. She has to deal with the cameras and embarrassing moments that will be seen by all her high school peers and friends, even though there are tons of cameras, mistakes, and of course drama, Maddy and Julia will always stick together to get through the many obstacles that they face in their everyday life.
title: Really Me

overview: Japan has a conviction rate of 99.9% for criminal cases that goes to trial. A lawyer is able to defeat those odds and obtain an acquittal for his client, even though there's conclusive evidence that says otherwise. Sometimes, due to minor things, good and evil can switch sides and good people can become bad people.
title: Anti-Hero

overview: Inside Politics is a political talk show, broadcast on CNN. Originally hosted by Catherine Crier and Bernard Shaw, and then Shaw and Judy Woodruff, the show ran from 1992 to 2005 before being cancelled.
title: Inside Politics

overview: From bobbing businesses to continuous cruisers, we meet the vibrant community who call the UK's canal network home.
title: Narrow Escapes

overview: Jamie Oliver takes us on a joyful journey of sumptuous spring flavours, as he re-awakens the kitchen garden after winter.
title: Jamie Cooks Spring

overview: Adventures of Cord, a Civil War veteran working undercover for the Army.
title: Gunslinger

overview: It revolves around two youths of the Qian Hu Troops with contrasting personalities, who work together to solve cases.
title: The Great Pei

overview: The young and successful CEO Liu Xi is a capitalist at work and a playboy in his personal life. He often belittles women, causing much distress and harm to the women around him, yet remains unaware of his behavior. One day, an unexpected accident occurs, and Liu Xi's soul is transported into the strict household of a marquis, where he becomes Liu Xizhao, a young lady who is bullied by various forces within the household due to her high-status marriage. Liu Xizhao's husband is Lu Shaoyang, the frivolous fourth son of the Changping Marquis household. When Liu Xizhao, with his modern scoundrel mindset, clashes with the ancient playboy Lu Shaoyang, the two are completely incompatible. Liu Xizhao shocks Lu Shaoyang with his bold and unconventional actions. Before Liu Xizhao can adjust to his new identity, his mother-in-law drags him off to learn the household rules. Unable to accept the constraints of traditional female roles, he becomes desperate to escape. In his eagerness to return, Liu Xizhao defies the marquis household's rules, leading to his house arrest. Trapped in the back courtyard, Liu Xizhao is forced to endure the oppressive patriarchal customs and begins to understand the difficulties of being a woman. He is judged by traditional moral standards, finally grasping what it means to be indoctrinated and morally constrained. To protect his friends and himself from harm, Liu Xizhao embarks on a journey of leveling up and battling adversaries. He becomes proficient in the intricacies of household scheming, power struggles, and business warfare. Armed with his unique worldview and modern business acumen, he blazes an unstoppable path to victory.
title: Hard Noble Lady

overview: Good luck, and don't f*ck it up! Watch your favorite RuPaul's Drag Race lip-syncs with an exciting and hilarious twist - no music?! Relive these HER-storic lip-sync battles, as your favorite queens click heels, crack bones, and create chaos in this gag-worthy re-dub of RuPaul's Drag Race's most iconic performances.
title: LipDub

overview: Join James St. James and co-hosts Fenton Bailey and Randy Barbato as they talk to the leading New York nightlife figures of the 1970s, '80s, '90s, and beyond. Featured guests include Dianne Brill, Michael Musto, Peter Gatien, Lisa Edelstein, Moby, and Joey Arias among others. It's campy, it's gossipy, it's jaw-droppingly funny...definitely must-hear podcasting.
title: Night Fever

overview: The history of the heroes of the serial epic begins in the mid-sixties of the last century, when the protagonists of the everyday saga Ruslan and Anfisa did not even know that soon their lives take place great changes, and they will have a daughter named Dink, which will be an extraordinary and strong person . On its share falls many trials: meeting and separation from loved ones, the birth of their children, find true happiness that will be subject to the spectacular everyday novel, the final scenes which takes place in these days.
title: Пятая группа крови

overview: Mike and Elvis are going global! This time, the stakes are higher, the deadlines tighter and the motor transformations are more jaw-dropping than ever.
title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour

overview: The amnesiac girl killer Yueyao finally faced her first killing mission at the age of sixteen. Yueyao was ordered by her master to assassinate the "cruel" General He Yunxing of the Fourteenth Yamen. Yueyao failed to sneak into the general's mansion to assassinate her, and was tricked by He Yunxing into becoming his newly married bride!
title: The Killer Bride

overview: The series is set in the late Tang dynasty of China. Li Shimin played a pivotal role in the battles leading up to the collapse of the Sui Dynasty, yet his father and founding Emperor Li Yuan, instead created his eldest son Li Jiancheng as the crown prince. The brothers' relationship quickly deteriorated, and Li Shimin ambushed and killed Li Jiancheng and younger brother Li Yuanji at Xuanwu Gate in 626. Wei Zheng served as advisor to Li Jiancheng during the princes' contention for power, yet was pardoned and later promoted to the position of left (senior) chancellor after impressing Li Shimin with his honest advice and constructive criticism. He works together with Li Shimin to create a flourishing Chang'an.
title: Peace in Palace, Peace in Chang'an

overview: An old body-burning case is reopened, and Officer Chen Jianghe is urgently called back to his small town. Upon returning, he's swept into chaos—schemers, a lying killer, and revenge-driven victims, all closing in like a raging sandstorm. Yet, Chen believes every storm ends, and justice will prevail once the dust settles.
title: Sandstorm

overview: This sitcom features the band members alongside a host of comedic guest stars, who are depicted as wannabe musicians struggling to make it. Other characters include Sloman, their perverse neighbour; Chevy, their iniquitous manager; and Zoe, Stef's long-suffering girlfriend. As well as slipping into wild music videos, the series sees the band having to cope with day-to-day challenges like sharing a dingy East London flat, trying to impress girls when they have no cash, and working out who has to sleep on the kitchen floor. The series charts their failures and successes as they try to claw and hobble through a sea of bizarre obstacles and unsavoury characters toward pop stardom.
title: The Midnight Beast

overview: Former friends Kwok Pak Fei, Keung Hei Man, and Lau Lik reunite years after a botched operation led to a tragic death and estrangement. Now, a gruesome murder case tied to a human trafficking ring forces them to work together. As they investigate, mysterious messages appear with clues about the crimes, hinting at knowledge from the future. Together, they form a special unit, ASIB, to decode these messages and solve the chilling case.
title: Anonymous Signal

overview: Rival plastic surgeons Qiao Yang and Zhou Jingwen, trained under the same mentor, find themselves brought together by fate at their most vulnerable moments. As the leading doctors at their respective cosmetic surgery clinics, they head their teams through intense debates and confrontations over beauty standards, women's roles in the workplace, and the true essence of a healer's compassion.But when a far greater threat looms, the two women put aside their differences and unite against the dangerous underworld of illegal cosmetic practices. In their fight to restore the dignity of their profession, they also rediscover a more...
title: Fight for Beauty
The Enlightened Path Wang Yang Ming's Journey

overview: In the unforgiving Australian Outback, a new generation of treasure hunters is risking it all in a new rush for riches. In the hostile Australian Outback, five courageous crystal hunting teams confront extreme conditions, from scorching deserts to frigid underground mines, in a bid to unearth some of the world's rarest and breathtaking crystals. Fuelled by celebrity endorsements and a four-trillion-dollar-a-year global wellness industry, the crystal trade is booming, and Australia has some of the most ancient & richest deposits on earth. Outback Crystal Hunters are on a quest to uncover these geological marvels - from giant million-dollar Amethyst clusters to magical, colour-changing Zircons. All these impassioned crystal hunters are driven to unearth and showcase these ancient wonders to the world while hungry to secure a life-changing payday.
title: Outback Crystal Hunters

overview: Welcome to the brain of one of the sickest puppeteers ever encountered - Neil Patrick Harris.
title: Neil's Puppet Dreams

overview: Set in the province of Haidong, the drama follows prosecutors Hong Liang and Zheng Yaping as they reopen the notorious "Wan Hai Organized-Crime Case" in Dongping City. During their review they uncover evidence that judicial insiders bent the law to shield the syndicate. Using a whistle-blower tip as their entry point, the team dismantles the criminal network and brings the corrupt officials behind it to justice.
title: In the Name of Justice

overview: Hu Yong'er encountered a saintess by chance, and was taught magic skills from the heavenly sealed book. Sheuses the skills to help the poor, but was arrested by the government. Hu Yong'er has nowhere to escape, and could only run back to the saintess, who turned out to be the leader of the Tushan Sect and her birth mother. Hu Yong'er also discovers that the one who is pursuing her is her own elder brother, Zuo Mo, who betrayed Tushan Sect for his own selfish gains. Zuo Mo wants to capture Hu Yong'er to learn about the secret magic of he sealed book and revive the fox tribe. To save the world, Hu Yong'er, under the guidance of her mother, learned the magical arts of the skilled book and defeated the evil forces.
title: The Legend of Sealed Book

overview: In the early morning of a spring day in the capital city, Su Lili, the owner of Suji Coffin Shop, happened to rescue a young man named Mutou. However, no one knew that she was the daughter of a former prime minister from the previous dynasty, and he was the son of the current lord Linjiang. They fall in love with each other and live a peaceful life. However, Mutou, who carried a hidden identity, suddenly went missing. In this chaotic and wandering world, Su Lili's true identity was discovered by Qi Fengxiang. He was cunning and ruthless, determined to vie for power, and tried to keep her by his side, but his path of a king is destined to be lonely. Can he provide her a peaceful life, and can she give him boundless freedom? And what about Mutou, who once said, "If I can fly away, I will fly back"? Where did he ultimately "fly" to, and can he "fly" back?
title: Su Ji

overview: If you thought you knew the Grande Dame Diva of the South, you've got another thing coming. The new series starring the Dancing Diva herself!
title: Alyssa Raw
